source_refs.title: Set up Family Sharing (title not confirmed by WebFetch)
source_refs.section: Invite people to join your Family Sharing group
source_refs.applicability: iPhone (the page also covers iPad; this ref covers the iPhone steps)
source_refs.verified_excerpt: The child can enter their account password on your device to accept the invitation.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: Open Settings, then tap Family. Tap the Add Member button. Tap Invite Others to add an adult, or a child who already has a Child Account. If the child has no Child Account, tap Create Child Account, then follow the onscreen instructions. The child can enter their account password on your device to accept the invitation. Follow the remaining onscreen instructions to set up parental controls, location sharing, and more. You can send the invitation by text or email. To check whether someone accepted, tap their name under Family. To resend, select Resend Invitation.

source_refs.title: Set up Family Sharing (title not confirmed by WebFetch)
source_refs.section: Join a Family Sharing group; If you can't accept the invitation
source_refs.verified_excerpt: You can be a part of only one Family Sharing group at a time. If you can't accept the invitation, check if someone else joined a Family Sharing group with your Apple Account.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On iPhone: You'll get an invitation to join a Family Sharing group by email or in a text message. You can respond directly from that invitation. Open Settings, tap your name, then tap Invitations. To accept, complete the onscreen instructions. You may be asked to confirm your Apple Account information and opt in to features the group has set up. You can be a part of only one Family Sharing group at a time. If you can't accept the invitation, check if someone else joined a Family Sharing group with your Apple Account.
